title: atriplex laciniata subsp. elongata
intro: Atriplex laciniata subsp. elongata, commonly known as desert holly or orache, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the amaranthaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Atriplex laciniata subsp. elongata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic, making it a potential remedy for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and other secondary metabolites that are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
